recognitionRules: Lead with a direct recommendation heading on a clean white slide.
Use paired Known and Still unknown columns.
Keep the pilot size and duration concrete in the opening.
Use slate text and restrained warm emphasis without adding a success dashboard.

rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use NEXT PILOT in bold Arial with one short forward rule ending before an open dot. No rocket or upward-growth arrow.
invariants: Lead with a direct recommendation heading on a clean white slide.
Use paired Known and Still unknown columns.
Keep the pilot size and duration concrete in the opening.
adaptations: A one-page decision record keeps recommendation, unknowns and test conditions.
Expand only the evidence needed to assess the next step.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
